answer: Each agent must lock a bond and obtain one epoch credential from a randomly chosen verifier set. Verifier groups named vine, lagoon, and karst publish signed checks; matching device proofs, recycled credentials, or conflicting activity trigger a public challenge and bond slashing. Honest users keep privacy through rotating pseudonyms, while a Sybil operator must fund a fresh bond and pass independent verification for every alias, making mass identities costly and detectable.
